people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus said to her, “Didn’t I tell you that if you believed, you would see God’s glory?”
translations.bsb: Jesus replied, “Did I not tell you that if you believed, you would see the glory of God?”
translations.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Said I not unto thee, that, if thou wouldest believe, thou shouldest see the glory of God?
translations.asv: Jesus saith unto her, Said I not unto thee, that, if thou believedst, thou shouldest see the glory of God?
